question: ______ enables a user to remotely access another computer and terminals over the Internet.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telnet**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Telnet is a network protocol used on the Internet or local area networks to provide a bidirectional interactive text-oriented communication facility using a virtual terminal connection.
 
• It was developed in 1969 and standardized as one of the first Internet standards by the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF).
 
• Telnet clients are available for virtually all platforms, allowing users to log into remote systems using the command-line interface.
 
• Telnet is often used by network administrators for remote management of servers and network devices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **HTTP (HyperText Transfer Protocol)**

 
 
• HTTP is the protocol used by the World Wide Web, defining how messages are formatted and transmitted, and what actions web servers and browsers should take in response to various commands.
 
• It is the foundation of any data exchange on the Web and it is a protocol used for transmitting hypertext requests and information.
 
• HTTP is designed for distributed, collaborative, hypermedia information systems.
 
• It is an application layer protocol in the Internet protocol suite model.
 
 
 
• **UseNet (User Network)**
 
 
• UseNet is a worldwide distributed discussion system available on computers.
 
• It was developed from the general-purpose UUCP architecture of the same name.
 
• UseNet is used for posting messages (called articles or posts) to newsgroups, and these posts are then distributed to other servers.
 
• It was an early example of online collaboration and remains in use today.
 
 
 
• **FTP (File Transfer Protocol)**
 
 
• FTP is a standard network protocol used to transfer computer files from one host to another over a TCP-based network, such as the Internet.
 
• It is a client-server protocol that relies on two communications channels between client and server: a command channel for controlling the conversation and a data channel for transmitting file content.
 
• FTP is commonly used to upload web pages and other documents from a private development machine to a web hosting server.
 
• It is also used to download files from a server to a local computer.
